item.name: Enable or disable a connected account

request.name: Enable or disable a connected account

description.content: Updates the status of a connected account to either enabled (active) or disabled (inactive). Disabled accounts cannot be used for API calls but remain in the database.

variable.description: (Required) The unique identifier of the connected account

response.name: Successfully updated the connected account status. If enabled=true, the account status is set to ACTIVE; if enabled=false, the status is set to INACTIVE.
